lines.line: has not spoken to Pim since Pim broke its fishing rod last spring
follows Pim everywhere and does whatever Pim does
shares everything it has with Ottoline and with nobody else
owes Pim a debt it has never repaid
has cooked the house's supper every night for a year
is the only hob who can work the forge
tends every injury in the house; hobs come to it when they are hurt
keeps the count of the house's stores and writes it on the board each morning
right now: has not eaten since yesterday morning
right now: has a badly cut paw and cannot carry anything
right now: its closest friend died three days ago; it has barely eaten or slept since
right now: was praised by the visitor in front of everyone yesterday
leaves a small offering on the shelf for the visitor every morning
says out loud that the visitor does not exist
slightly prickly: now and then takes a remark the wrong way
extremely prickly: takes offence at almost everything, snaps at once, never forgives
a little brave: will face a small danger if it must
utterly fearless of physical danger: walks into fire, onto thin ice, toward wild animals
